For the Petitioner : Mr. Mohit Prakash, Advocate  Ms. Jyoti Nayan, Advocate For the State : Mr. Azeemuddin, A.P.P  --------
06/ Dated 16.02.2024  Heard the parties.

The petitioner has been made accused in connection with Ichak P.S. Case No.149 of 2022, Spl.
POCSO Case No.15 of 2023, for the offences under Sections 376 & 506 of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 4 & 12 of POCSO Act, pending in the court of learned Additional Sessions Judge-III-cum-Special Judge, POCSO Act, Hazaribagh.

entities.text: Additional Sessions Judge-III-cum-Special Judge, POCSO Act, Hazaribagh
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Petitioner is said to have established physical relationship with the prosecutrix.
Both of them had understanding that the petitioner will marry her.
Subsequently, the marriage could not be solemnized.
Learned A.P.P on behalf of the State has submitted that the medical report of the victim is not available on record.
He has further submitted that the headmaster of the school in his Letter Pad has given a certificate regarding the date of birth of the victim, according to which, she is a minor.

The statement of the victim under Section 164 Cr.P.C is available on record, in which, she has admitted that she had entered into the consensual physical relationship with the petitioner according to her own wish.
Considering the aforesaid fact, I am inclined to release the petitioner, on bail.

Accordingly, the petitioner, named above, is directed to be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.20,000/-(Rupees Twenty Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each, to the Aditya Kumar vs The State Of Jharkhand ..... ....
